title: 2026371 Varonis Interceptor Subscription Service Renewal
description_text: This solicitation is being made pursuant to the M/WBE Small Purchase Method, Section 3-08 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board (PPB) Rules, this procurement is exclusively for the New York City Certified Minority and Woman Owned Business (M/WBEs). Contracts awarded under this method may not exceed $1,500,000, inclusive of any and all change orders, overruns, amendments, renewals and extensions. Annual license/support for the Varonis Interceptor For Email SaaS Subscription for Varonis for Microsoft 365. Varonis is a Data Security Platform designed to detect cyber threats from various sources by analyzing data, account activity, and user behavior. Varonis Interceptor Software Support and Maintenance for Email Saas Subscription (QTY: 560) The coverage term is from 12/12/2025 - 07/31/2027. This is a cloud based procurement. Annual billing.
